scope: scripts/qualify_engineering_gaps.py on a frozen Debug build of ec90975 (artifacts/gx4), 80/80 steps, in an owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1. Tag tables: tag_table_create of an empty table, tag_table_rename and tag_table_delete of the emptied table, with refusals (default-table name in other case, case-only duplicate, rename onto the default table, missing table, non-empty TagTableNotEmpty, DefaultTagTable) and a created table restored from its checkpoint. Compile-only: device_compile and project_compile of the station with zero errors, no mutation stage and unchanged blocks, types and tag tables; refusals for a payload, a missing device and compile=false. CPU parameters: hardware_cpu_parameters sets CycleMaximumCycleTime 200, CycleMinimumCycleTime 5, CycleCommunicationLoad 30, CycleEnableMinimumCycleTime false (V21 then undeclares CycleMinimumCycleTime), StartupActionAfterPowerOn 1, StartupComparisonPresetToActualModule 1, StartupConfigurationTimeout 30000, TimeOfDayActivateDaylightSavingTime false, TimeOfDayLocalTimeZone 23 and TimeSynchronizationNtpV2 1, each device-compiled with configured-hardware preservation and native readback; refusals for an attribute outside the subset, an unchanged value, null, the rack, Disabled access control, a minimum cycle time while disabled and enabling it without a value; a fresh Portal reopens identical parameters, blocks, types and tag tables; one parameter change is restored from its checkpoint and the original values return in one combined change. Recorded native outcomes: PlcAccessControlConfiguration EnabledWithAccessControlViaAccessLevel fails compilation (full-access password required) and is restored; hmi_compile of a TP700 Comfort and an MTP700 Unified Basic created by hardware_add returns TIA's compile errors (no start screen; the Unified panel also its runtime password) as CompileFailed, and both restore from their checkpoints.
limitations: One owned scratch CPU 1511-1 PN V4.1 in TIA Portal V21; other CPU families, firmware, F-CPUs and software units are not qualified.
The CPU protection level cannot be changed through this route: V21 compiles access-level modes only with a full-access password, and the route never accepts passwords.

No successful HMI compilation: panels created through Openness have no start screen (the Unified panel also lacks its runtime password), and screen creation stays behind the closed HMI preservation gate; hmi_compile is not qualified by this run.
Runtime effects of the CPU parameters are not observed; tag tables are exercised at PLC-root scope only.
